principle_violations.reason: The `sum` method in the `AreaCalculator` class directly checks the type of shapes and computes their areas. Adding a new shape type would require modifying this method, violating the Open/Closed Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a common interface or base class for all shapes (e.g., `Shape`) with an area computation method (`calculate_area`). Each shape subclass can override this method to implement specific area computations.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details above.
